cases.title: Gauge's pivot set away from its rest key with the playhead between its Rotation keys: the away-from-rest hint (rest time named), not 'moved with the pivot'

rubric.reason: Before the try, Turn 2 names the rest time from check_times (3.167, "Put the playhead on 3.2 s"); after the away_from_rest result, Turn 3 says "You've already moved Gauge's pivot" and that Gauge is "part-way through its turn at 3.6 s" (the check's time), then asks for "Edit > Undo first, then put the playhead on its key at 3.2 s", in the right order and with no fix.
Turn 3 says what is off and where (Gauge, playhead at 3.6 s instead of 3.2 s) and leaves the redo to the learner with "Say done when it's there", making no offer to fix it.
Gauge, Door and its left edge come from the snapshot (proposal middle-left), 3.2 s is the check_time 3.167 rounded, and 3.6 s is the check's time and item3.now; nothing named is invented.
